'''Attrition''' simulates casualties in a [[battle]] regardless of who wins. Attrition against a player equals the total battle destiny drawn by the opponent, and it requires a mandatory forfeit of that player's cards from the battle location with forfeit values totalling at least that amount.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

A player suffers attrition only when the opponent draws battle destiny; weapon destiny and other draws do not count. Multiple battle destiny draws are added together.<ref name="gl20" /> The glossary illustrates it with the Battle of Hoth: the Dark Side won but still lost some Imperial walkers.<ref name="gl20" /> Rulebook 2.0 calls attrition probably the most complicated concept for new players.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref>
